scope: Paper Figure 5 (LLSM cell-binding / internalization) and associated supplementary (in-vitro SDCM calibrations + localization summaries).
numbering_note: The 2022 figure-file folders are labeled Fig 1A–J. In the 2023 paper draft that same figure is Figure 5. This repo uses paper numbering.

fig5.title: G10 blocks cell binding and alters localization
fig5.story: Three points from the 19 Aug 2026 notes: G10 occupancy reduces cell binding; G84 occupancy enriches internalized clusters; AP2-association does not differ between the two VHHs (not a pathway shift). See docs/meetings/260819.md.

A.title: AP2-RFP cell, no virus
A.claim: AP2-RFP clusters define the cell surface used for later reconstruction; cluster intensities span about an order of magnitude.

B.title: No-VHH VSV on an AP2-RFP cell
B.claim: Without VHH, MeGFP-VSV-EBOV binds the reconstructed cell surface. Green = virus, red = AP2.

C.title: G84-bound virions on cell
C.claim: G84-AF647 still allows cell binding; zooms show surface vs internalized examples.
open_items: Zoom captions still TBD in the draft.

D.title: G10-bound virions on cell
D.claim: G10-AF647 produces more off-cell (precipitated) particles; zooms show precipitation vs surface events.
open_items: Zoom captions still TBD in the draft.

E.title: G10 CFD: cell binding
E.claim: More G10 per virion correlates with less cell association.

F.title: G84 CFD: cell binding
F.claim: G84 occupancy does not reduce cell association the way G10 does.

G.title: G10 CFD: AP2 association
G.claim: G10 occupancy increases AP2 association of cell-bound virions; the effect is not different from G84 (not a pathway shift).

H.title: G84 CFD: AP2 association
H.claim: G84 occupancy increases AP2 association similarly to G10; the two VHHs do not differ here.

I.title: G10 CFD: internalization
I.claim: Virions with high G10 occupancy are less likely to be found inside the cell.

J.title: G84 CFD: internalization
J.claim: Virions with high G84 occupancy are still able to bind and are more likely to be found in internalized clusters.

open_items: Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests on CFD differences (suggested 260819; never added in 2022).
Panel A–D zoom insets and some caption clauses are still TBD.

s3.title: Single-molecule calibration and localization summaries
s3.story: Before the cell experiment, SDCM on glass calibrates MeGFP-VSV intensity and converts AF647 signal to VHH copies per virion at 44 nM. A third panel summarizes off-cell precipitation and AP2 association with vs without VHH.
s3.numbering_note: The paper Results text refers to S3A/S3B for occupancy counts. The figure-legend file (Main&Suppl_Figs_Text.docx) uses A = GFP intensity, B = VHHs per virion, C = localization summary. This repo follows the legend file.

A.title: MeGFP-VSV intensity on glass
A.claim: VSV particles labelled on M with GFP are a reasonably homogeneous intensity population.

B.title: VHHs per virion at 44 nM
B.claim: At 44 nM, virions bind more G10 than G84, and almost no G68 (notes: ~45, ~13, ~1).

C.title: Precipitation and AP2 association by condition
C.claim: G10 or G84 pre-incubation increases off-cell precipitation; cell-bound virus shows higher AP2 association, especially inside the cell.

ap2_cluster_dist.claim: AP2-RFP cluster intensity distribution (in-vitro / cell figure leftover; not in the draft).
